## Description and Rationale

I have several years of software development experience and a strong interest in machine learning and data science. I have also won three Telegram developer contests (contest.com) . I would like to apply this experience to the PRC Data Challenge by developing a robust ML solution for taxi-out time prediction using real-world aviation data.
